notes: Input API: emulator.input {buttons:[...], port:N} sets the full held set (see analysis/toolkit-issues.md TK-001). Route tokens: 'btn[+btn]:hold:after' = hold buttons for `hold` frames then release and run `after` frames; 'wait:N' = run N frames. Frames counted by emulator.step unit=frame from emulator.start (power-on). Tracing: trace.configure enabled, capacity 0 (aggregates only); tracing slows emulation ~10x, so some long stretches ran untraced (stated per milestone). Snapshots were disposable same-build files and were removed at handoff; routes are the durable record. | r1-a redirect: snapshot files for S09 were scratch and are removed; routes + patches above reproduce them (~1-3 min each untraced; tracing slows ~20x).
